checks: For local same-field linear lifts the scalar kernel is prime to p; normalized different increases by at most one by exact tower transitivity. No inference from normalized different to highest upper break.

Canonical invariant lattices have inverse divisor B=sum ceil(p(d_x+1))*x. Slope window depends only on deg B. Choosing H of degree 2g+4+ceil(deg B/(p-1)) and fixed terms H^(-3ir) gives exact length7/3 presentations with O_p(f(g+deg B+1)r^2) coordinates and constant equation degree.
Local tests use variable lengths L_x with total O_p(sum c_x+|P|); multiplication and one-step Frobenius have bounded polynomial degree regardless of jet length.
Existing full local lattice comparison supplies all-Artinian Isom openness. The complete component prefactor and the (q-1)^|P| linear-lift tuples are included.
Pulling the one fixed detecting curve back to an index-t cover yields a connected degree-t cover and surjects onto H. No new Bertini choice is made.

Galois core of each finite H-representation lies normally in Gamma; one finite Gamma quotient trivializes it and the coset cover. The original detector gives its uniform normalized different at each original branch.
Exact tower formula gives d_y=e_y(b_x+1)-delta_y. The genus, number of marks, sum d_y and all local frame lengths are O(t), without multiplying maximum depth by number of marks.
At each fixed completed surface source the connected local cover degrees sum to t. Each factor representation determines all associated curve branches; count each surface factor once.
Bounded local geometric periods are the exact condition. Global geometric period or gcd(r,q-1) is sufficient, extras outside T are trivial. No semilinear or unrestricted-period assertion.
